reviews.title: Best High-End looking base
reviews.comment: If you're on the hunt for an affordable yet well-built RGB keyboard base, this keyboard has got you coverd. Priced competitively, it manages to deliver a sturdy construction without compromising on quality. It’s durable enough for daily use, and the finish is sleek and minimalist, offering a modern look that fits well with any desk setup. One of the most impressive features of this keyboard base is its RGB lighting. The lighting is vibrant and customizable, offering a range of effects that can be easily adjusted through software or keyboard shortcuts. You can choose from a variety of pre-set profiles or create your own, with the ability to tweak brightness and speed. The RGB illumination provides a captivating glow that enhances your gaming or typing experience, making it a visual treat without breaking the bank. In terms of performance, the keyboard base is surprisingly good for its price. The layout and key switch compatibility ensure smooth typing and gaming. While the base itself doesn’t come with switches or keycaps, it’s highly compatible with most standard key switches, making it an excellent base for custom builds. The mounting options for stabilizers are stable, and the base doesn’t flex much, even under heavy use, which is a nice bonus at this price point. What truly sets this keyboard base apart is its affordability. While many RGB keyboard bases on the market can be quite expensive, this one offers a budget-friendly alternative without sacrificing the quality you’d expect from a premium product. It’s a great option for anyone looking to build their own keyboard but doesn’t want to spend a fortune on the base alone. Whether you're new to custom keyboards or an experienced enthusiast, this RGB base offers a perfect balance of performance, aesthetics, and value.

reviews.title: Great Barebones board
reviews.comment: I order the first one which 2 keys did not work, i believe this was due to water damage because it was heavily raining the day it was delivered. I returned it and got another one back and it works perfectly fine. The software is pretty good and all the led features work and it also works with signal rgb which is a huge advantage, but you do have to disable the glorius software first. I got gatreon brown linear switches and it is very quite, and has a very nice feel to it. The noise level is perfect for my needs and is not picked up by any mics. I did buy the Barebones, which was a pretty good price. the keycaps I got with it are https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D541DJWW/?coliid=I20UVEF1S9QNY6&colid=8IWVDSFIR9KI&ref_=list_c_wl_lv_ov_lig_dp_it&th=1 note this is not an affiliates link. They are fully compatible with this keyboard.

reviews.title: Seriously good, but one flaw.
reviews.comment: I was planning to wait on writing a review to see how this thing is in a few weeks, but I was so impressed that I felt inclined to write one now. I ordered the prebuilt one as I was planning on just getting the barebones, keycaps and switches, but this one was on sale for cheaper than the barebones, so I got it. I also ordered Kahil jades and different keycaps. I'm not a fan of linear switches, but out of the box, I was seriously considering keeping the ones it came with as they are so incredibly smooth, sound amazing, and have a good actuation force (I was in Best Buy earlier this week looking at keyboards, and the closest one to this that I tested was a $250 Logitech board, this one is seriously good feeling). Anyways, I decided to stick to the original plan and throw my new switches on there, and I am still very impressed. Good sound, stabilizers do not rattle, and the keys don't move around. Build quality is very good, nice and heavy. Looks great on my desk. One complaint is the lighting. The software is a bit tricky to use and the lights just aren't that bright, and the color is off. -1 star for that. Everything else exceeded my expectations.
